objective: Make sustained work-time behavior and exact SAME MAIN reservation renewal the two immediate P0 outcomes; adopt Product Runtime Direction ideas only when they directly improve these outcomes.
acceptance_criteria: Normal nonterminal CONTINUE wake sustains at least 10 minutes (600 observed elapsed seconds) unless a truthful non-CONTINUE exception applies.
SAME MAIN provisional schedule is live-verified at wake + exactly 11 minutes (660 seconds) and normal close is live-verified at ACTUAL END + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds).
All human-readable critical timing carries explicit human unit plus exact seconds; hourly RRULE recurrence cannot reinterpret offsets.

Product Runtime Direction adoption remains bounded to goal-over-mechanism, evidence-grounded recursive improvement, stable-vs-experimental promotion, prior-art-before-invention, and precise-internal/natural-language-external reporting separation.
Natural-language turn reporting is recorded as final-distribution UX direction, not allowed to replace structured internal telemetry or become the current optimization target.
No broader planner/profile/adapter productization work displaces the two P0 runtime goals before they are empirically proven.
checkpointable_substeps: Persist operator priority and bounded Product Runtime Direction adoption decision.
Reconcile stale durable state and policy wording that can misdirect work-time or reservation timing.
Strengthen deterministic enforcement/tests for exact timing semantics and bounded-turn close behavior where gaps remain.
At or after 10 minutes (600 seconds), finish the smallest safe in-flight unit, checkpoint, live-verify SAME MAIN ACTUAL END + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds), project the due consistently, and close.
early_finish_fallback: Audit current runtime timing/work-time surfaces for ambiguity, stale generation state, or missing deterministic enforcement; do not expand into unrelated product features.
